review_notes: I read the whole file and the sibling NativeCommRingGlobalSections file that it builds on. I grepped SheafCohomology for simp and reassoc attributes. This file declares no simp or reassoc lemmas. I found no loops and no competing rules. The one issue is the missing reassoc/simp interface on the coprojection lemma, which is judged only from how the two lemma statements are written and used. I did not check whether adding `simp` would fire without trouble: the right-hand side contains `eqToHom` and `Γ.map`, so it may need testing. I did not run Lean.

findings.excerpt:
theorem colimit_ι_nativeCommRingCylinderSectionsComparison (i : Set.Ici i0) :
    colimit.ι ((restricted S i0 U0).rightOp ⋙ SheafedSpace.Γ) i ≫
        nativeCommRingCylinderSectionsComparison S i0 m U0 =
findings.problem: This is the defining coprojection law of the comparison map, like `colimit.ι_desc`. It has no `@[reassoc]` and no `simp` attribute. The comparison is a plain `def`, so simp cannot see through it. The lemma is therefore never usable as a rewrite when the composite sits inside a longer chain. Both downstream proofs work around this by hand. `originalStage_nativeCommRingCylinderSectionsComparison` uses a 3-step `calc` with an explicit `Category.assoc _ _ _` step and a `congrArg (eqToHom … ≫ ·)` step. `exists_nativeCommRingCylinderSections_stage` uses a `rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply]` followed by `rw [colimit_ι_…]` and then `change` steps. The sibling lemma `colimit_ι_nativeCommRingGlobalSectionsComparison` has the same gap and is also rewritten by hand with `← Category.assoc`.
findings.proposed_change: Mark the lemma `@[reassoc (attr := simp)]`, as Mathlib does for `colimit.ι_desc`. Its left-hand side is the composite `colimit.ι … ≫ nativeCommRingCylinderSectionsComparison …`, which is in normal form. The right-hand side has only `Γ.map … ≫ eqToHom …`, which is strictly smaller and cannot loop. With the generated `colimit_ι_…_assoc`, the `calc` in `originalStage_…` reduces to one `rw [colimit_ι_…_assoc]` followed by the final `restrictOnNamedPreimage_Γ_map` step. Apply the same attribute to the global-sections lemma so that the rewrite at line 59 becomes a plain `simp`/`rw`.
findings.benefit: Users and later proofs can rewrite the comparison through the coprojection, including under a left-composed `eqToHom`. The manual associativity and `congrArg` plumbing disappears from the proofs at lines 62–101 and 140–181. The comparison's characterising property also becomes part of the simp interface, so it is no longer hand-applied each time.
